name: Calibration
source:
Mankind is just one step away from the perpetual motion machine, flying cars, and other unimaginable technologies. But first, we must put corruption behind us. Project Judge will administer justice in a new world. But is it possible to train an AI to do this?

[From [url=https://kukoldin.itch.io/calibration]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
人类距离永动机、飞行汽车等难以想象的技术仅一步之遥。但首先，我们必须将腐败抛在身后。项目法官将在新世界中主持正义。但有可能训练人工智能来做这件事吗？

[来自[url=https://kukoldin.itch.io/calibration]Itch.io[/url]]
